purpose: Correct the scientifically failed head-only V1R3 by aligning AEE direction labels with the sealed Cano 3-degree component-center target and adapting the full encoder to the real AEE missing-return pattern.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-2 three-seed full-encoder adaptation run using only the exact sources, method, metrics and failure policy in this card.
approval.confirmation_reference: After reviewing the exact V2 data, method, 39/39 then 41/41 tests, cost, acceptance criteria, zero-data preentry proof and proposal preflight boundary, the user explicitly replied '批准'.

raw_sources: Sealed AEE V1R3 tunnel train trajectories, seeds 11/23/37/53/71.
Sealed AEE V1R3 garage validation trajectories, seeds 11/23/37/53/71.
Sealed DAE-multilayer objective teacher V1R with 6000 labels.
Sealed Cano V2R C01-C08 train split and C09 retention validation split.
Frozen M1D source checkpoints for seeds 0/1/2.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of sealed project and M-TARE/AEE development assets.

sampling.rule: Use the sealed every-fifth temporal sample identities, giving a 1.0 s median interval and 2.0221309158052296 m median adjacent displacement over all effective frames; the source collector also enforces at least 50 m spatial coverage per independent trajectory. No sample is deleted or added.
sampling.temporal_rule: Exactly every fifth synchronized AEE frame; no deletion or resampling.
sampling.independence_note: The 3000 AEE-mask-matched Cano views are deterministic augmentations of the same 3000 Cano samples and are never counted as independent observations.

teacher.source: Frozen DAE-multilayer support plus PLY obstacle objective teacher V1R.
teacher.evidence_target: The original 720-bin binary traversable mask is preserved unchanged in the sealed teacher shards.
teacher.learning_target: Connected exit-component centers encoded with the same sealed Cano circular Gaussian sigma=3 degrees.
teacher.valid_mask: All 6000 records are unique, finite, nonempty and direction/count/role consistent.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No future trajectory, model output, graph output, C09 result or strict-test data enters labels.

method.model: The existing StructuralSemanticNet initialized from the matching frozen M1D seed; encoder, embedding and all three heads are trainable.
method.domain_matching: For each selected dense Cano sample, pair one AEE train valid mask deterministically. A Cano return is retained only where both masks are valid; newly invalid normalized ranges become 1.0. A Cano miss is never invented as a return.
method.view_weighting: Dense Cano and mask-matched Cano each receive weight 0.5; raw AEE receives weight 1.0, preserving equal total Cano/AEE domain weight.
method.validation: No validation augmentation. AEE garage is the adaptation validation domain; sealed Cano C09 is retention-only and the second checkpoint-selection key.
method.optimization: Seeds 0/1/2, ten epochs, AdamW learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4, independent batch size 128, no hyperparameter search.

split.historical_pollution_audit: AEE tunnel/garage are development-only; Cano C09 is retention-only; C10 and later benchmark worlds remain sealed.

baseline.scientific: Immutable V1R3 head-only seed0 result: AEE direction F1 0.029503, empty rate 0.886, count macro-F1 0.084205, role macro-F1 0.157502 and Cano direction delta -0.082392.
baseline.direction: Frozen AEE garage range-sector B0 F1 0.301158.
baseline.retention: Each source M1D seed evaluated on sealed Cano C09 before adaptation.

per_seed: AEE direction F1 is at least its frozen B0 F1.
AEE empty direction rate is at most 0.05.
AEE count macro-F1 over present common branch counts 1-4 is at least 0.70; counts 5-6 are diagnostic only.
AEE role macro-F1 is at least 0.70.
Cano C09 direction F1 loss is at most 0.02 from the matching source checkpoint.
All model tensors are finite and encoder, embedding and semantic heads all change.
C10 and later sealed-world reads remain zero.
acceptance.aggregate: All three seeds must pass; otherwise the complete run fails and no seed is promoted.

estimated_cost.compute: Three serial RTX 5090 D jobs; expected 30-60 minutes, hard internal limit 4 hours; zero simulation.

evidence.machine_metrics: Input/checkpoint/tool/environment hashes; per-epoch independent/view counts; mask provenance; three histories/checkpoints; AEE/Cano metrics; full model tensor-change and finite checks; forbidden-world read counters.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Preserve all 3000 AEE validation outputs per seed for deterministic overlays; pass/fail uses complete metrics.
evidence.failure_policy: Any source, environment, determinism, count, metric, retention, forbidden-read or resource failure stops and seals without retry, threshold change or partial promotion.
